lines.translation: He came into the world to obtain the four great blessings.
He came to dwell in the home of the Shiva and Shakti, energy and matter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਿੜ ਹਾਰੇ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: ek visaare taa piR haare a(n)dhulai naam visaaraa he ||6||
lines.translation: But he forgot the One Lord, and he has lost the game. The blind person forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||
The child dies in his childish games.
They cry and mourn, saying that he was such a playful child.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਸੋ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਭੂਲਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saa so tin hee leeaa bhoolaa rovanahaaraa he ||7||
lines.translation: The Lord who owns him has taken him back. Those who weep and mourn are mistaken. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhar joban mar jaahi k keejai ||
lines.translation: What can they do, if he dies in his youth?
They cry out, "His is mine, he is mine!"

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰੋਇ ਵਿਗੂਚਹਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa kaaran roi vigoochahi dhrig jeevan sa(n)saaraa he ||8||
lines.translation: They cry for the sake of Maya, and are ruined; their lives in this world are cursed. ||8||
Their black hair eventually turns grey.
Without the Name, they lose their wealth, and then leave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਮੂਠੇ ਰੋਇ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: duramat a(n)dhulaa binas binaasai moothe roi pookaaraa he ||9||
lines.translation: They are evil-minded and blind - they are totally ruined; they are plundered, and cry out in pain. ||9||
One who understands himself, does not cry.
When he meets the True Guru, then he understands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਨ ਖੂਲਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur bajar kapaat na khoolahi sabad milai nisataaraa he ||10||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, the heavy, hard doors are not opened. Obtaining the Word of the Shabad, one is emancipated. ||10||
The body grows old, and is beaten out of shape.
But he does not meditate on the Lord, His only friend, even at the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam visaar chalai muhi kaalai daragah jhooth khuaaraa he ||11||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he departs with his face blackened. The false are humiliated in the Court of the Lord. ||11||
Forgetting the Naam, the false ones depart.
Coming and going, dust falls on their heads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: saahuraRai ghar vaas na paae peeeaRai sir maaraa he ||12||
lines.translation: The soul-bride finds no home in her in-laws' home, the world hereafter; she suffers in agony in this world of her parents' home. ||12||
She eats, dresses and plays joyfully,
but without loving devotional worship of the Lord, she dies uselessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: sar apasar kee saar na jaanai jam maare kiaa chaaraa he ||13||
lines.translation: One who does not distinguish between good and evil, is beaten by the Messenger of Death; how can anyone escape this? ||13||
One who realizes what he has to possess, and what he has to abandon,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sa(n)g sabad ghar jaanai ||
lines.translation: associating with the Guru, comes to know the Word of the Shabad, within the home of his own self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸਚਿ ਖਰਾ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: kis hee ma(n)daa aakh na chalai sach kharaa sachiaaraa he ||14||
lines.translation: Do not call anyone else bad; follow this way of life. Those who are true are judged to be genuine by the True Lord. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਿਝੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saach binaa dar sijhai na koee ||
lines.translation: Without Truth, no one succeeds in the Court of the Lord.
Through the True Shabad, one is robed in honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhas lae tis bhaavai haumai garab nivaaraa he ||15||
lines.translation: He forgives those with whom He is pleased; they silence their egotism and pride. ||15||
One who realizes the Hukam of God's Command, by the Grace of the Guru,
comes to know the lifestyle of the ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam japahu tar taaree sach taare taaranahaaraa he ||16||1||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, chant the Naam, and cross over to the other side. The True Lord will carry you across. ||16||1||7||
Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har saa meet naahee mai koee ||
lines.translation: I have no other friend like the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin tan man deeaa surat samoee ||
lines.translation: He gave me body and mind, and infused consciousness into my being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sarab jeeaa pratipaal samaale so a(n)tar daanaa beenaa he ||1||
lines.translation: He cherishes and cares for all beings; He is deep within, the wise, all-knowing Lord. ||1||
The Guru is the sacred pool, and I am His beloved swan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saagar mahi ratan laal bahu saare ||
lines.translation: In the ocean, there are so many jewels and rubies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: motee maanak heeraa har jas gaavat man tan bheenaa he ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord's Praises are pearls, gems and diamonds. Singing His Praises, my mind and body are drenched with His Love. ||2||
The Lord is inaccessible, inscrutable, unfathomable and unattached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har a(n)t na paaeeai gur gopaalaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord's limits cannot be found; the Guru is the Lord of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satigur mat taare taaranahaaraa mel lae ra(n)g leenaa he ||3||
lines.translation: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Lord carries us across to the other side. He unites in His Union those who are colored by His Love. ||3||
Without the True Guru, how can anyone be liberated?
He has been the Friend of the Lord, from the very beginning of time, and all throughout the ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: daragah mukat kare kar kirapaa bakhase avagun keenaa he ||4||
lines.translation: By His Grace, He grants liberation in His Court; He forgives them for their sins. ||4||
